lines.4: That exchange sounded strangely like a married couple.
lines.6: 「They went home. Kurogane and Date are at club practice.」
lines.7: Right, Crab and the others went to see that live show.
lines.8: I wasn't all that interested in things like that.
lines.9: 「So, do those guys actually work when they're here at headquarters?」
lines.12: 「I'm getting pummeled out there. Telling me to recruit someone that brutal... The Princess can be cruel.」
lines.14: 「She doesn't hesitate to call me disgusting.」
lines.18: 「Tsushima, I'm almost finished. Would you like to walk home together?」
lines.20: 「The sunset looks wonderful from here. Have some tea while you wait.」
lines.22: It felt rude to think it, but she was almost like a maid.
lines.23: I poured the tea straight down my throat.
lines.27: 「Sorry. Was it a little too hot?」
lines.28: 「No, it was my fault for trying to chug it.」
